header.title: Библиотека анархо-либертарианства
header.description: Тщательно подобранная коллекция ресурсов, статей и книг по анархо-индивидуализму, анархо-капитализму и либертарианству.

booksList.title: The Ego and Its Own
booksList.author: Max Stirner
booksList.description: A foundational text of individualist anarchism, exploring the nature of the self and the rejection of all forms of authority.

booksList.title: Anarcho-Capitalism: A Primer
booksList.author: Murray Rothbard
booksList.description: An introduction to the principles of Anarcho-Capitalism, advocating for a stateless society based on voluntary trade and private property.

booksList.title: The Ethics of Liberty
booksList.author: Murray Rothbard
booksList.description: A comprehensive exploration of libertarian ethics, arguing for a society based on natural rights and voluntary cooperation.

booksList.title: For a New Liberty
booksList.author: Murray Rothbard
booksList.description: A classic work advocating for a free society based on individual liberty, private property, and voluntary cooperation.

booksList.title: Anarchy, State, and Utopia
booksList.author: Robert Nozick
booksList.description: A philosophical exploration of the nature of the state, individual rights, and the concept of a just society.

booksList.title: For a New Liberty
booksList.author: Murray Rothbard
booksList.description: A comprehensive guide to libertarian principles and the case for a free society without government.

booksList.title: The Market for Liberty
booksList.author: Murray Rothbard and Karl Hess
booksList.description: An exploration of how a free market can provide for all societal needs without the interference of the state.

booksList.title: Anarchism: A Very Short Introduction
booksList.author: Colin Ward
booksList.description: A concise overview of anarchist thought, its history, and its relevance in contemporary society.

booksList.title: Libertarianism: A Primer
booksList.author: David Boaz
booksList.description: An accessible introduction to libertarian principles, covering topics such as individual rights, free markets, and limited government.

booksList.title: The Anarchist Cookbook
booksList.author: William Powell
booksList.description: A controversial book that discusses various aspects of anarchism, including tactics and strategies for resisting authority.
